snippet.title: Chemical Combat | Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Hey everyone! I'm super proud to announce that Chemical Combat has now launched in early access after months of hard work. Apologies for the delayed release, but hopefully everything goes smoothly from here on :)

🏷️ Available now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3490250/Chemical_Combat/

💭 Join the Discord server to give any feedback:
https://discord.com/invite/NxDSW65sUY

🎬 See how the game was made:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLdCLXFnLGVkDi819PJWZBBoNhcDzZCGev
